title: maint.event.v1{kind=retrain_approve}
description: Phase 8 §8.1 — operator-published manual override that authorizes a trainer run. Carries `target=<predictor_id>` and `request_id` correlated to the drift event's request_id (so the trainer can join the two on the bus).

request_id.description: UUID — operator-issued; the corresponding drift retrain_request.request_id MAY be carried in `details.drift_request_id` for join (optional).
